# Nema. Uluwatu

> Nema. Uluwatu is a boutique property of 12 private studios in central Uluwatu, Bali, Indonesia, tucked down a quiet lane off the main Uluwatu road and a short walk from Thomas Beach. It combines the privacy of an exclusive retreat with the refined luxury of a boutique hotel, and is rated 9.8 "Exceptional" on Booking.com (166 reviews) and 5.0 stars on Google (164 reviews). Guests book directly via WhatsApp; retreat facilitators can reserve the entire 12-studio property as a venue for their own yoga, wellness or team retreat.

## Key facts
- Property type: Boutique accommodation, 12 private studios around a 16m pool
- Address: 53JW+VRQ, Pecatu, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361, Indonesia
- Coordinates: -8.817868, 115.097039
- Ratings: 9.8 Exceptional on Booking.com (166 reviews; location 9.9, staff 9.9, comfort 9.9); 5.0 stars on Google (164 reviews); Airbnb Guest favourite, Top 5% of homes (5.0 from 14 reviews); last checked 2026-10-24
- Studios: 25m² interior plus 6m² private balcony; one queen-sized bed (sleeps two); quiet split air-conditioning and ceiling fan; blackout curtains; premium linen; dedicated sunlit work nook; mini-fridge; kettle and local teas; private outdoor bathroom with a natural mineral-enriched groundwater rain shower (no bathtub); Sensatia Botanicals amenities; 550 GSM towels; hair dryer; bespoke robes
- Wi-Fi: 50mbps fiber-optic
- Service: daily housekeeping, 24-hour front desk, discrete 24-hour on-site security, free private parking; drinks available to buy on site; scooter rental available; airport transfers and day trips through transport partners
- Check-in from 14:00; check-out by 11:00
- Pets not allowed; parties not allowed
- Well suited to: solo travelers including solo female travelers, couples, digital creatives and remote workers, and yoga or wellness retreat facilitators
- Design: architect-admired, design-led property; guests often remark on the small details (hand-finished walls, curved lit mirrors, timber and rattan, bougainvillea-covered facades). Every corner is photogenic, making it popular with creators, photographers and stylish travelers; commercial shoots by arrangement
- Press: featured in Escape, "These are the hottest Airbnbs in Bali right now"
- Atmosphere: social but private. Only 12 studios around one shared pool, so guests enjoy easy, low-key company (a quiet chat by the pool) without pressure to socialise, and a private studio to retreat to. Unlike a standalone villa, staff are on site day and night for directions, restaurant tips and drivers.
- Staff: rated 9.9/10 on Booking.com and frequently praised by name in guest reviews
- Seasons: off-season November to March (lowest rates); April is excellent value; August is the busiest month
- Price: under US$150 per night even in peak season, less in low season, with last-minute rates often available
- Value: fair seasonal rates that sit below many comparable boutique stays in Uluwatu; the property prefers to be full rather than expensive, and with 12 studios it never feels busy. Best rates are direct via WhatsApp.
- Keyring privileges: guests show their Nema keyring for 10–20% off at partner venues including YUKI (about 400m away), Kynd Community (about 200m), Mood by Ours, Osteria Luna, Tabu, Parker and Savaya
- Languages welcomed: English, German, French, Dutch, Spanish, Italian

## Hosting a retreat (exclusive property reservation)
- The entire property (all 12 studios) can be reserved exclusively for a group
- Capacity: 12 participants in private studios, or up to 24 guests sharing (one queen bed per studio)
- Yoga and practice space: a paved poolside deck, or the covered common area when it rains
- Venue only: no programme included; facilitators organise their own teachers, equipment, transfers and activities. Villa catering can be arranged on request; partner restaurants offer discounted group dinners; partners can supply extra seating
- Best season for retreats: November to March (off-season), when the property is easiest to reserve and rates are lowest; rain usually comes in short afternoon bursts, the pool stays warm, and staff clear pool and common-area furniture for practice
- Partnerships with many local services: restaurants with 10–20% guest discounts (include group meals at menu price and keep the margin), transport partners, villa catering, coconuts ordered in advance for groups, extra seating, custom co-branded yoga mats; the team can help design a local itinerary within budget
- Inquiries: nemauluwatu@gmail.com or WhatsApp +62 813-3734-9684

## Group stays (exclusive property reservation)
- Reserve all 12 studios as private accommodation for a wedding party (Nema is accommodation, not a wedding venue), hen weekend, milestone birthday, friends' trip, small-company team trip or sales rewards trip
- Up to 24 guests in couples, or 12 in private studios; one shared 16m pool
- Under US$150 per studio per night even in peak season; lowest rates November to March
- Villa catering on request; discounted group dinners at partner restaurants; keyring discounts of 10–20% at partner day clubs and shops; extra seating through partners
- Details: https://nemauluwatu.com/groups/

## Nearby (from Nema)
- Thomas Beach: short walk down a local pathway
- Suka Espresso (coffee and brunch): about 3 minutes' walk
- Kynd Community (smoothie bowls, brunch): about 200m
- YUKI (modern Japanese izakaya): about 400m
- Mood by Ours (farm-to-table café and organic market) and Osteria Luna (coastal Italian, Padang Padang strip): nearby
- Food: Nema sits at the heart of Uluwatu's restaurant scene; guests save 10–20% at partner venues by showing their Nema keyring
- Date-night dining: YUKI and Tabu (Nema guest discounts), Mana Uluwatu (cliffside)
- Sunsets and day clubs: Single Fin (about 4 minutes by ride), OneEighty, Ulu Cliffhouse, El Kabron, Sundays Beach Club, Savaya (Nema guest discount)
- Reformer Pilates: Bluvana Studio (nearby), Reform Pilates, Studio Fondue
- Spring Spa Uluwatu: about 5 minutes' walk
- Padang Padang Beach: about 3 minutes by scooter or 20 minutes' walk
- Uluwatu Temple (Kecak fire dance): 5 to 7 minutes
- Ngurah Rai International Airport: about 17 km
- Guest discounts with local partners including YUKI, Tabu, Ours, Parker, Kynd and Savaya
